What did I end up naming the app?.cypher:
MATCH (t:Topic {name:'アプリ名'})<-[:ABOUT]-(d:Decision)<-[:CONTAINS]-(c:Conversation)-[:ON]->(v:Vendor)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(old:Decision)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:BECAUSE]->(r:Reason)
RETURN d.id AS id, d.statement AS statement, d.date AS date, d.status AS status,
       v.name AS vendor, r.text AS reason, old.id AS old_id, c.id AS conv_id
ORDER BY d.date DESC
LIMIT 1

Did my monetization plan change? Why?.cypher:
MATCH (t:Topic {name:'収益化'})<-[:ABOUT]-(new:Decision)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(old:Decision)
MATCH (newConv:Conversation)-[:CONTAINS]->(new), (oldConv:Conversation)-[:CONTAINS]->(old)
MATCH (newConv)-[:ON]->(newVendor:Vendor), (oldConv)-[:ON]->(oldVendor:Vendor)
OPTIONAL MATCH (new)-[:BECAUSE]->(r:Reason)
RETURN new.id AS id,
       new.statement AS statement,
       new.date AS date,
       newVendor.name AS vendor,
       old.id AS old_id,
       old.statement AS old_statement,
       old.date AS old_date,
       oldVendor.name AS old_vendor,
       r.text AS reason,
       newConv.id AS conv_id,
       oldConv.id AS old_conv_id
ORDER BY new.date
